desc: Implement input reading and build adjacency list for tree with NK vertices.
Root tree at vertex 1, do iterative post-order DFS (avoid recursion limits).

At each node, collect child return values, apply two-pointer greedy pairing: pair lengths a,b with a+b+1==K; leftover single path extended by 1; if extension reaches K return 0, else return length; if more than one unpairable, return failure.
Handle edge cases: K=1 always Yes; K=2 means perfect matching check.
Print Yes if root returns 0 and no failure, else No.
Verify the greedy solution against samples and edge cases (star graph, path graph, N=1, K=2 matching, deep chain) and fix any bugs found.
